description: Spreads between venues for the same market, as perpdexlist.com/arbitrage shows them: every symbol on two or more of Lighter RH, main Lighter and Hyperliquid (crypto, and its stock, index and commodity perps), with each venue's mark and hourly funding. funding: the highest hourly funding minus the lowest, what a short where it is highest and a long where it is lowest earn an hour on each leg before fees, and that rate held a year (not a forecast). price: the dearest mark over the cheapest. tradable: both funding legs are on venues an AINDEX agent trades now (Lighter RH, main Lighter, and Hyperliquid's own perps where the service trades there; its stock perps are read only). Sort by funding or price; only venues trading at least min_volume a day count. Whether one is worth taking (fees on both legs, how long it lasts, margin on both sides) is a judgment; an AINDEX agent puts both legs on together as one linked trade.
name: get_spreads
title: Spreads between venues
